replacement: “Gentlemen, we’re all cruel, we’re all monsters, we all make men weep, and mothers, and babes at the breast. But let it be settled here, now: of all of us, I am the lowest reptile! I swore to reform, and every day I’ve gone on doing the same filthy things. I understand now that men like me need a blow, a blow of destiny to catch them like a noose and bind them by a force from outside. Never, never would I have risen by myself! But the thunderbolt has fallen. I accept the torture of the accusation and my public shame. I want to suffer, and by suffering I will be purified. Perhaps I will be purified, gentlemen? But listen, for the last time: I am not guilty of my father’s blood. I accept my punishment, not because I killed him, but because I meant to kill him, and perhaps I really might have killed him. Still, I mean to fight it out with you. I warn you of that. I’ll fight it out with you to the end, and then God will decide. Good-by, gentlemen. Don’t be angry with me for shouting at you during the examination. Oh, I was such a fool then.... In another minute I’ll be a prisoner, but now, for the last time, as a free man, Dmitri Karamazov offers you his hand. In saying good-by to you, I say it to all men.”

“I’ll trouble you, sir, to learn how to speak to me, if nobody’s ever taught you. I’m not ‘old fellow’ to you, and you can keep your advice for another time!” Mavriky Mavrikyevitch snapped savagely, as though glad to vent his anger.
